title: WalkwayReach
description:
What hiding objects, with the paths over them cut out or repaired, does
to the ways characters take near them (ADR 0059).

after.description:
What the paths are compared with: the paths over the objects cut
out (ADR 0052), or repaired.

changes.description:
The destinations whose way changes, the worst first: cut off before
longer ways.

checked.description: How many destinations near the objects were checked.

place.description: The worldspace or interior cell asked about.

cell.description:
Where it lies, for people: an interior cell's internal name, or the
worldspace and the cell's grid position.

kind.description: What kind of place it is.

name.description: Its name: the one players see where known, else the internal one.

position.description: Where it stands, in whole game units.

usedBy.description:
For an object a quest or routine uses: that quest or routine, by its
internal name.

DestinationKind.description: What kind of place characters walk to.

oneOf.description: A door, which may lead into another cell.
Furniture: a bed, a chair, a work station.
A spot where characters stand or do something, an idle marker.
A place of the world map.
An object a quest or a character's routine sends characters to.

ObjectRef.description:
A placed object, by the plugin that placed it first and its number in
that plugin. Unlike a form ID as the game shows it, this does not
depend on the load order.

localId.description: The object's number in that plugin.

ReachAfter.description: What the paths after hiding are.

oneOf.description:
The triangles over the hidden objects are taken out of the paths
(ADR 0052): what characters would walk on if nothing is added.

The paths are repaired with new triangles around or under the
hidden objects.

ReachChange.description: How the way to one destination changes.

after.description: The way after, if there is one.

before.description:
The way before. For a destination cut off, the shortest way from
where the paths lead on into the rest of the world.

from.description:
For a longer way: where the way is measured from, another
destination nearby.

ReachOutcome.description: What happens to the way to a destination.

oneOf.description: What characters stood on to use it is gone with the hidden object.
No way leads there any more.

A way still leads there, but a much longer one, or one only
through the places around that were not looked at.

Route.description: A way characters walk, to draw.

metres.description: How long it is, in whole metres.

points.description:
Its points from start to end, in whole game units, in the
coordinates of the worldspace or the interior cell.
